text: welcome
this is your moment to arrive into the day with clarity
find a comfortable position
Let your eyes soften and allow your body to settle into the surface beneath you.
Take a gentle breath in and exhale slowly, again breathing in freshness and breathing
out anything you no longer need.
Notice the newness of this moment.
Each inhale carrying a sense of possibility.
Each exhale clearing space for what matters most.
Now imagine soft morning light filling the space around you.
Warm, bright, gentle.
With every breath, see this light filling your body, illuminating the mind, easing the heart,
steadying the spirit.
Repeat silently.
I begin with clarity.
I move with ease.
I carry calm into my day.
Once more, I begin with clarity.
Take one last deep breath in, exhale fully.
And when you're ready, softly open your eyes.
forward into the day with steady presence.
